data.name: GAS
data.detailed_description:
DRIVE. LOOT. SURVIVE.

GAS is a co-op survival horror roadtrip where you and your friends build a junk car, scavenge cursed islands, haul valuable loot, and survive the night.

Spawn at your main base with nothing but empty hands and bad ideas. Search abandoned buildings, garages and forests for car parts, fuel, weapons and anything valuable enough to sell. Every run is different - islands, roads, bridges and loot are procedurally generated.

During the day, wolves and bears guard useful supplies deep in the wilderness.

At night, the skeletons come.

And every night they get stronger.

BUILD YOUR CAR

Your car is your lifeline. Find engines, wheels, doors, fuel tanks and tools to assemble a working vehicle piece by piece. Repair damage, manage fuel, and somehow keep the thing alive long enough to reach the next island. Because walking through skeleton-infested forests at midnight is a terrible idea.

HAUL PRECIOUS CARGO

Load your trunk with valuable junk and transport it safely to extraction platforms inspired by physics-based co-op chaos. Throw loot onto the platform at the shop, watch it launch away, and collect your cash reward. Heavy furniture. Fragile antiques. Weird cursed garbage. If it fits in the car, it’s profit.... assuming the skeletons don’t steal it first.

SURVIVE THE NIGHT

Daytime is scavenging time. Nighttime is war. Skeleton hordes emerge after dark, roaming forests and roads in search of players, loot and vehicles. They can steal cargo, destroy your car, and drag your entire run into disaster. Fight back using melee weapons, shotguns and automatic rifles - or run for your life and pray the bridge is still standing. Every island increases the danger. Every night escalates the chaos. If the whole team dies, the run is over.

MINI-BASES BETWEEN ISLANDS

Every bridge leads to a small safe zone where survivors can:

-Sell loot

-Buy weapons and upgrades

-Refuel and repair

-Respawn dead teammates

-Gamble money in the casino

-Prepare for the next island

But safety never lasts long!

PHYSICS, PANIC & FRIENDSHIP

Everything becomes harder with friends yelling nearby.

Online co-op for up to 4 players

Physics-based objects and cargo

Shared vehicle management

Dynamic day/night cycle

Procedurally generated islands

Increasing nightly difficulty

Permadeath run structure

One player drives.

One reloads the shotgun.

One forgot to bring gasoline.

And one definitely attracted the skeletons.

FEATURES

  • Build and maintain a fully functional vehicle

  • Explore procedural islands connected by dangerous bridges

  • Loot buildings, forests and abandoned structures

  • Physics-based cargo extraction system

  • Dynamic day/night gameplay loop

  • Skeleton hordes that grow stronger every night

  • Wolves and bears hunting during daytime

  • Melee combat, shotguns and automatic weapons

  • Sell loot, gamble and upgrade between islands

  • Online co-op with proximity voice chat

  • Permanent run failure when the entire team dies

  • Endless replayability through procedural generation

data.short_description: A co-op road trip horror for 4 players from the fan of Spintires, MudRunner and SnowRunner. Loot by day. Survive the night. Defend your car from skeletons, monsters and bad decisions. Go GAS! Go FUN!
data.supported_languages: English, German, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 2.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Win 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 3.0 GHz or AMD
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 or RX 7600xt or equivalent
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
